email.subject: Quick fix for Pulse Pros' website
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

I checked out Pulse Pros Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors can't tap to ring you and probably just leave for a gym that lets them call instantly. And your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people searching "gym open now near Harbor Falls" can't tell if you're open and move on.

Both are quick, flat-fee fixes. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
